summary: The implementation provides a UI framework with placeholder backend functions for thumbnail generation, enhancement, and video analysis. All frontend requirements (REQ-1, REQ-3, REQ-5, REQ-7, REQ-9) are implemented with proper UI components, but all backend processing requirements (REQ-2, REQ-4, REQ-6, REQ-8) are only stubbed with empty implementations that return empty blobs or arrays.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend accepts text prompts and returns generated thumbnail images; Images are stored and retrievable; Error handling for failed generation attempts
missing_requirements.reason: Backend function generateThumbnailFromText only returns an empty blob (Blob.fromArray([])). No actual image generation, storage, or error handling is implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend receives uploaded images and processes them for enhancement; Enhanced version is stored and returned to user; Original upload is preserved for comparison
missing_requirements.reason: Backend function enhanceThumbnail only returns an empty blob. No image enhancement processing, storage, or original preservation logic exists.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend accepts video URLs and extracts or generates thumbnail imagery; Generated thumbnail captures the essence of the video; Thumbnail is stored and returned to frontend
missing_requirements.reason: Backend function generateThumbnailsFromVideo returns an empty array. No video URL processing, thumbnail extraction/generation, or storage is implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend processes customization parameters sent from frontend; Modified thumbnail is generated and stored; Updated thumbnail is returned to user
missing_requirements.reason: Backend function applyCustomizationsToThumbnail only returns an empty blob. No parameter processing, thumbnail modification, or storage exists.

hallucinated_features.description: Social media links in header (Twitter/X and GitHub icons)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly states 'Social media sharing features' as a non-goal, yet the header includes social media icon links
